reviews.text:
Terrible service and negligence at the Sherman Oaks location. I boarded my 10-month-old puppy at Dog-E-Den for four days. When I picked her up, I knew something was wrong. I live just 5 minutes away, and the exact moment we walked through my front door, she had severe bloody diarrhea. I rushed her to the vet immediately, and she was prescribed Panacur C for 3 days due to a severe parasite infection.
When I contacted them to address their lack of supervision during her four-day stay, they completely washed their hands of the situation. They absurdly claimed she "never had diarrhea there," which is impossible given how sick she was the minute we got home. They flat out refused to refund my money or take any accountability. They do not monitor the dogs properly or care about their well-being. Do not risk your pet's health at this place.
Cosmo loves it here! He has all his doggy friends and hoomans are so sweet to him!
We love Dog-E-Den! My dog is always so happy to come for daycare and boarding and he is cared for so well by the staff. Thank you!

I'm really thankful this facility does temperament tests rather than just take your money and put a dog in an uncomfortable situaton. My dog gets anxious when surrounded by multiple animals, and sure enough when he was walked in for his test, he was surrounded immediately (maybe because he was new). He didn't respond well, and the employee picked him up. All the animals (I was watching the monitor from the lobby) surrounded her legs, trying to get to my dog). She put him down in the middle of them, and this time he ran, trying to get away. They did chase him. I believe all the dogs in there were just trying to play with him, but he clearly was not having it. She brought him back out to me. A lot of other places would have just let him be uncomfortable in the space. I appreciate they did not do that. I should point out that I don't think they should have put him down in the middle of a group of excited dogs, either, but thankfully they got him out of there quickly when they saw he didn't like it.

I just want to say that this place has been amazing for Leo!  We have used Dog-E-Den for day care and boarding, and Leo has loved it.  What I love the most is that all the staff are so loving with all the dogs and they send the cutest reports every day.  The web cams are also a great thing, especially if you leave them for longer periods of time.  I want to thank all the staff (Vicky especially, April and all the amazing young people that have loved Leo so much.  For personal reasons, Leo will be spending more time with a friend so I won't be using Dog-E-Den for a while, but I want to thank everyone for being so amazing. I hope to come back soon.

I have to say if I could give more stars than five for Sherman Oaks Dog-E-Den daycare, I absolutely would!!!!
All of the staff are kind and loving to my fur baby and I have to give a special shout out to Victoria!! Not only does she show all the dog’s there, love and affection, but she goes out of her way to send special report cards, and pictures of my Little guy. I feel safe and confident that my dog is more than cared for every time I drop him off.
I would recommend this Dog-E-Den to anyone looking for a clean, professional and loving environment for their fur babies. 🙌🏼🐶
Dog-E-Den Sherman Oaks is a clean and well run facility with very reasonable prices.

Absolutely Wonderful!!!!
The groomer Patty does an exceptional job and always exceeds my expectations.  The girls at the front desk are so friendly and professional. They are extremely patient and kind.
Everyone there is clearly committed to excellence!!! 5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Very professional and caring for the wellbeing of the dogs
Such a great place! I boarded my pup for a family trip and she was in the best hands. Thank you so much!
Staffs are amazing and friendly.  They will take care of your dog with most loving way.
We are using this place for the past several years and it's a great place for my dog.

Our baby loves this place! he comes home tired, happy, and fed. We love how the staff treat him and we can tell he loves them too because every time we drop him off he knows exactly where to go and his tail is always waggin! We love that they send us pictures/report cards of his day and the webcams are super helpful because I can spy on my little one. overall I would highly recommend Dog-E-Den.
Wonderful experience! I was worried about my dogs anxiety and they were so kind knowledgeable and positive ! My dog has a new place to play ! Thanks

I boarded my 11 year old dog for 9 days at Dog-E-Den in a private room.  It was a very easy & smooth experience making a reservation, checking him in & out and felt he was in very safe and capable hands while I was away.   Their live webcams are a great perk as well!

They simply love dogs here at Dog-E-Den in Sherman Oaks. I was very nervous because my 13 year-old male cockapoo is a shy guy, but I needed a place for him to stay during the day for several months. Their flexibility with drop-off, pick-up and extended hours was especially helpful. The staff greeted him with such enthusiasm and kindness each day.There was always a human in the den with the dogs who paid special attention to individual animals when needed. Our dog eventually started mixing with the others, and soon looked forward to going. The staff sends home photos and a “report card” each day; our dog’s playful changes were evident.

We returned, today, after a long absence. He received a warm welcome, and after a brief hesitation, jumped back into the play.
My dog loves coming here and the employees very clearly love him too. 11/10 would recommend

I brought my Shih Tzu to Patty, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! My poor pup had some serious matting, and I was worried about how he would handle the grooming process. But Patty was incredibly gentle and patient, putting both my dog and me at ease.

When I picked him up, I was amazed at how great he looked! His coat was soft, fluffy, and perfectly trimmed, with no signs of the mats that had been there before. Patty really took the time to ensure my dog was comfortable and happy throughout the process.

I can’t recommend Patty enough! If you’re looking for a groomer who truly cares about your pet and does an outstanding job, this is the place to go.
My girl Cece actually smiles when we get to the door.  She still smiles when I pick her up.  The staff takes great care of her so we visit as often as possible. Thanks Dog E Den!!!
Very friendly staff! Clean facilities. It was a win win for me!
Today was my pups first time at Dog E Den. April was my associate. She was kind and professional. I was anxious too. We're going back tomorrow.

I've been taking my Husky here for about 3 years, and she always has a good time. The staff do a good job of creating a safe play environment for all dogs. There are also webcams for customers to access to see how well there dog is doing. They also send emails with pictures to show how they spend the day. All in all, I'm happy to have found a place that has taken good care of my dog.
This is a vibrant place with staff who really love dogs and understand the wants and needs of their parents
Absolutely loved it! My puppy loved it too! Super nice, super helpful! Made me feel so comfortable & safe leaving my puppy with them! Definitely will be bringing her here!

It was my first time at doggy den with my new rescue. Frank and the staff was so wonderful. The place was very clean and I felt like the dog was taking care of in a safe environment to have a good time.
